source_selection: Single PARSEC plagioclase sheet with authenticated 0-degree apparatus. Distinct enstatite/olivine setups excluded, no numerical assays opened. Additional Stony Brook workbook HTTP403 retained; no mirror or enlarged cohort.
prior: Publication qualitative size trends, calibration settings and historical model comparisons for all three fractions exposed. This is an archival, prospective numerical forecast lock, not previously unstudied samples.
access: Predictor receives all wavelengths and ambient emissivities, only C for SLE. G/K decoded by separate receiver after fixed arrays emitted, transferred and hash-verified. Physical workbook shares bytes; boundary is extraction logic. No target-derived CF, brightness temperature, intensity, fitted orientation, smoothing or clipping in inference. All568 rows each preparation. Target contribution in its own reported effective-emissivity transformation remains part of the measured quantity.
optical: Use all three complex refractive-index orientations of independent plag_nk. Literal Maetzler mie_abcd and mie formulas evaluated with scipy.special Bessel J,Y at calibrated wavelengths. Require complete native-optics support within 0.001 μm to accommodate tabular rounding, else refuse. Use source assumption 0.37 across all preparations, independent spheres and air nmed=1; actual packing unmeasured. Mean grain sizes fixed as authored. Weight orientations from each fraction’s own ambient only using deposited simplex-grid fit at steps .01. Correct equal-orientation spectrum vs mean of three orientation spectra; weight g by scattering cross section. Both directional arms share these fitted optics. Sum of coefficients and angular recurrences require physical finite values. No scientific output inferred on input refusal.

transport.seed_formula: Fixed random seed = 1 + big-endian uint64(SHA256(ASCII decimal replicate seed, colon, semantic label) first 8 bytes) mod (2^64−2). Labels include stage, nominal diameter and angle/axis as in forecast.py. The two runs have independent streams. No outcome-dependent restart.
angles: finite cone 15 degrees half angle (sensitivity only)
transport.grid: all supplied plagioclase wavelengths, 568 strictly increasing per preparation; native optical grid interpolated only within tolerance. Fixed three-sample moving average of brightness temperature, endpoint replicated, in every modeled spectrum including isothermal (published smoothing algorithm unnamed). Effective emissivity = B_lambda(Tb_lambda)/B_lambda(max(Tb)) over same entire grid. Apply same per-wavelength measured ambient/model-ambient compensation.

temperature.profile: T_depth minus delta*max(1-z/depth,0), nominal top depths 0,10,...,990 um, fixed black bottom at T[deepest]. Choose lowest calibration RMSE over source 32–63 only, loop tie break ascending bottom then delta then depth. Source interface temperature unobserved. 350K matches cup setpoint, 400K is author model assumption.

empirical: source_difference adds native aligned middle-fraction measured SLE minus ambient; source_ratio multiplies by measured SLE/ambient. Every target uses its own ambient input. Shared wavelength grids must agree within 1e-6 μm. No clipping; refuse any nonpositive denominator.
score: Whole-spectrum RMSE of released dimensionless effective emissivity (equal native bins). Two distinct held preparations, one spectrum per size. Primary first role must win on both versus hemisphere_source_fit, author_hemisphere_400K_source_fit, ambient_unchanged, source_difference and source_ratio, in each of two fixed independent MC replicates. All other roles are fixed diagnostics and may be stronger. Report errors per fraction/role, MAE, largest signed error and same-row all-arm error; per-branch coefficient metadata, CPU time, raw extremes; no general instrument or unique temperature inference.
instrument: PARSEC zero-degree nominal emission, 256-scan averaged spectrum. Normal is central-ray approximation. Unknown cone response, packing, angular/particle dependence, lamp adjustment and spectral self-normalization are material limits. Independent Stony Brook XLSX access returned HTTP403 before numeric values. Target physical source is deposited plagioclase subset only.
